title: Week 2 of working on a not so cozy alien horror game
author: Zenpher
selftext:
I'm mostly working on this as a fun way to decompress during evenings after work. Ironically the hardest part so far is getting the monster "AI" to behave in a swarm and surprise the player 1 on 1.

So far they listen for footsteps and gunshots, circle around when you’re looking their way, and sometimes climb onto roofs or into the tree/branches. They also will use shrubbery to hide and pounce on the player when walking.

It's still early but my day job is programming and something like this would have taken me a few months (probably more tbh) to put together. I know some people are pessimistic about ai game dev but I think it's a bit unfair given that the latest round of models have been out for only a few weeks now. There's going to be some great and creative things coming out even with all the slop.

comments.author: Syyr553
comments.body: I personally don't think Ai is good at making horror games tho but I should say prove me wrong.
